# Treat automatically generated tag keys as native-service output

The 2025 landing tested auto_tag and a later collision key auto_taga. At the fixed accepted source, tests instead expect auto=20tag and auto=20tag_1. The API delegates generation to MailServices.tags.addTag rather than maintaining a second encoder. The native service can fall back to a hashed key when its generated key is too long and appends numeric collision suffixes. Callers should use the returned key. This compares the selected current generator and tests; it does not count later generator changes as chronologically studied or prove every encoding input. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.

Scope: mail / components.
